human_instructions_incorporated.summary: Absorb the reference strongly while adapting it to the new product and copy.

creative_thesis.thesis_statement: The product should feel like the controlling intelligence inside a charged system, inheriting the reference's force and depth while redirecting them toward a new commercial claim.
creative_thesis.communication_problem: Transfer a strong visual reference without merely reproducing its object arrangement.
creative_thesis.creative_answer: Preserve the reference's asymmetrical mass, layered depth, energetic separation and environmental density, then reorganize their manifestations around the new product and copy hierarchy.
creative_thesis.desired_viewer_perception: The new piece belongs to the same high-energy visual system but is a purpose-built campaign composition.
creative_thesis.rationale: High transfer should preserve functional DNA; originality comes from adapting the system to the new problem.

commercial_psychology.rationale: The reference supplies intensity; the direction converts it into product authority.

narrative_tension.central_tension: Controlled intelligence versus volatile surrounding energy.
narrative_tension.environment_role: A responsive system activated by the product.
narrative_tension.relationship: Environmental energy bends around and reveals the product rather than decorating it.
narrative_tension.rationale: The product gains authority by controlling, not merely occupying, the visual world.

subject_strategy.expression_intent: Not applicable to a non-human product
subject_strategy.relationship_to_environment: Energy and layers react to its presence
subject_strategy.relationship_to_viewer: Presented as an object of command and desire

emotional_strategy.rationale: Energy attracts; control makes it premium.

visual_hierarchy.reason: The new commercial subject must own the reference system.
Transfers the reference DNA and demonstrates control.
visual_hierarchy.relationship_to_previous: Wraps around and points back to the product.

visual_hierarchy.reason: Translates the perception into a claim.

creative_concept.visual_world: A dense charged ecosystem reorganized by the product.
creative_concept.narrative_function: Show the product as the intelligence governing energy.
creative_concept.composition_logic: Retain asymmetrical mass tension but move the primary mass to create new copy space.
creative_concept.environment_logic: Density is functional evidence of a system responding to the product.
creative_concept.typography_role: Copy occupies controlled quiet space and counterbalances the dense product field.

candidates.concept_summary: Reference energy becomes a system controlled by the new product.
candidates.core_mechanism: Dense energy redirected around a stable product
candidates.decision_reason: Transfers the reference aggressively while solving the new hierarchy.

candidates.concept_summary: Keep the exact arrangement and replace the original subject.
candidates.decision_reason: Copies manifestation rather than transferring design logic.

candidates.concept_summary: Remove most reference energy for a minimal product portrait.
candidates.decision_reason: Unjustifiably weakens a user-requested HIGH transfer.

ideation.convergence_summary: The winner preserves composition logic, depth behavior and energy while changing object arrangement to serve the new message.

selected_direction.name: Command the Current
selected_direction.concept: The product reorganizes a charged layered environment inherited from the reference.
selected_direction.why_it_won: It keeps strong reference DNA without sacrificing new copy and product priorities.
selected_direction.core_visual_idea: Stable product control inside volatile layered energy.
selected_direction.creative_risk: Technical execution may preserve surface effects but lose the control narrative.
selected_direction.originality_strategy: Retain functional design behaviors and rebuild their manifestations around the new product.

visual_mechanisms.name: ASYMMETRICAL_MASS_TENSION
visual_mechanisms.function: Create force between dense product mass and copy space.
visual_mechanisms.rationale: Core reference DNA, reorganized rather than weakened.

visual_mechanisms.name: LAYERED_DEPTH
visual_mechanisms.function: Carry energy across foreground, subject plane and environment.
visual_mechanisms.rationale: Reference depth behavior is essential at HIGH transfer.

visual_mechanisms.name: EXPLOSIVE_BACKLIGHT_SEPARATION
visual_mechanisms.function: Separate the product as the stable controller of surrounding energy.
visual_mechanisms.rationale: Preserves energetic separation without locking technical lighting values.

accepted_anchors.director_decision: Accepted without weakening; layers will be rebuilt for the new product.
accepted_anchors.rationale: Depth is a primary carrier of the reference DNA.

accepted_anchors.director_decision: Accepted as behavior, with implementation open.
accepted_anchors.rationale: It separates the controlling subject from volatile energy.

modified_anchors.translator_recommendation: Preserve the reference's dominant left-side mass.
modified_anchors.director_decision: Move the dominant product mass to the opposite field while preserving asymmetrical tension.
modified_anchors.rationale: The new copy requirement needs quiet space on the left; the mechanism survives through a new arrangement.

director_overrides.director_decision: Mirror and rebuild the mass relationship around right-side product dominance.
director_overrides.rationale: Exact placement conflicts with copy; functional asymmetry remains intact.

adaptation_notes: Reference Transfer Plan already supplied sufficient mechanisms; no VKB authority was needed.

protected_elements.description: Exact supplied product identity and silhouette
protected_elements.reason: Commercial recognition cannot be traded for reference similarity.

creative_constraints.statement: Composition logic, depth logic, energy and environmental density must transfer aggressively where compatible.
creative_constraints.rationale: The requested transfer intensity is HIGH.

creative_constraints.statement: The left field must support readable campaign copy.
creative_constraints.rationale: Required copy cannot compete with dense visual mass.

banned_tropes.name: SURFACE_STYLE_COPY
banned_tropes.description: Copy reference colors and glow while discarding its composition and depth logic.
banned_tropes.reason: Creates shallow resemblance rather than transfer.

banned_tropes.name: GENERIC_TECH_GLOW
banned_tropes.description: Glow used as the sole signifier of premium technology.
banned_tropes.reason: Effects without narrative function dilute the reference DNA.

frozen_decisions.decision: Preserve high-intensity asymmetry, layered depth and energetic separation.
frozen_decisions.rationale: These are the accepted DNA anchors.

frozen_decisions.decision: Product dominates the right field and copy occupies controlled left space.
frozen_decisions.rationale: This is the director's resolved adaptation.

strong_guidelines.decision: Environmental density must respond to the product.

open_decisions.decision: Exact lens, lighting setup, layer geometry and material treatment.
open_decisions.rationale: Technical Room chooses implementations that realize the frozen behaviors.

confidence.rationale: Reference anchors and new constraints have explicit resolutions.

technical_handoff.creative_goal: Transfer the reference's visual force into a new product-controlled campaign system.
technical_handoff.selected_direction_summary: Right-dominant product controls dense layered energy while left negative space carries copy.
known_risks: Surface resemblance may replace functional transfer
